metadata.description: A personal AI framework for web design & development with Claude Code: engineering quality, accessibility, performance and design without AI slop.

plugins.name: sumi
plugins.description: Engineering core: adaptive workflow (trivial → delegated → feature file), line budgets, risk gates, context-free review lenses, HTML/CSS/JS/a11y/performance standards and safety hooks.

plugins.name: sumi-design
plugins.description: Anti-slop design direction: brief, anti-references, three divergent directions, cross-project repetition ledger, DESIGN.md tokens and motion rules. Orchestrates Impeccable, Taste and Emil Kowalski skills.

plugins.name: sumi-nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt 3/4 + Vue 3 + Firebase/Firestore stack pack: composables, SSR/hydration safety, data modeling, security rules, Tailwind.

plugins.name: sumi-react
plugins.description: React 19 + Next.js App Router stack pack: server/client boundaries, data fetching and caching, forms and actions, component architecture.

plugins.name: sumi-shopify
plugins.description: Shopify Online Store 2.0 stack pack: Liquid, sections, blocks, schemas, snippets, theme performance and CLI workflow.

plugins.name: sumi-wordpress
plugins.description: Native WordPress block themes (FSE, Gutenberg) with no build step: theme.json as the design system, HTML templates and PHP patterns, custom dynamic blocks (block.json + render.php) with plain-JS editors, core APIs over plugins, performance and token audits.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: [companion · pbakaus/impeccable · Apache-2.0] Design critique, audit, polish and anti-pattern detection. Referenced from upstream.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: [companion · DietrichGebert/ponytail · MIT] Minimalism rules against over-engineering; origin of the ponytail: comment convention. Referenced from upstream.
